授業科目の概要.曜日時限: 秋学期 木曜日 ２時限
授業科目の概要.授業科目に関する特筆事項: The course involves the study of the molecular composition of living cells. The biological macromolecules which this course focuses on are nucleotides including DNA/RNA, nucleic acids, amino acids, and proteins. Higher structure of nucleic acids and proteins are also examined. Methods and approaches used in biochemical research will be presented as will the biochemical basis of some diseases.

授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.授業科目の目的（日本語）: この科目では、生化学の基本原理を理解することを目的とし、特にDNA/RNA、核酸、アミノ酸、タンパク質の構造と性質について理解する。(英語での講義)
授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.授業科目の目的（英語）: The overall goal is for the student to understand fundamental principle of biochemical concepts. Upon completion of the course, the student should achieve an understanding of structure and character of DNA/RNA, nucleic acids, amino acids, and proteins.
授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.キーワード: Biological macromolecule, nucleic acid, nucleotide, amino acid, peptide, protein
授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.履修条件: There are no specific prerequisites. Due to classroom capacity, if demand exceeds capacity, priority will be given to students in the Faculty of Agriculture's International Course.
